tree.heading: Environs.—
tree.text: The term “environs” means the territory surrounding the District of Columbia included in the National Capital region.

tree.heading: National capital.—
tree.text: The term “National Capital” means the District of Columbia and territory the Federal Government owns in the environs.

children.text: Montgomery and Prince Georges Counties in Maryland;
Arlington, Fairfax, Loudoun, and Prince William Counties in Virginia; and
all cities in Maryland or Virginia in the geographic area bounded by the outer boundaries of the combined area of the counties listed in subparagraphs (B) and (C).

tree.heading: Planning agency.—
tree.text: The term “planning agency” means any city, county, bi-county, part-county, or regional planning agency authorized under state and local laws to make and adopt comprehensive plans.
